title: I make $25K/month from one simple website
description:
Meet Roman. He built Career Hound, a simple job board website that makes around $25K/month. It's a saturated idea, but the reason he's successful is NOT about the product. It's all about the marketing. This video is the story of how a "boring" product wins entirely on distribution.
*One-page websites making $10K/month:* https://clickhubspot.com/m8ed

Say hi to Roman: https://x.com/rlakhnyuk
Check out Career Hound: https://www.careerhound.io/

🔔 Follow the Second Channel: @StarterStoryBuild
🏁 We're hiring: starterstory.com/jobs
